title: First job at ten and the cheap first valve trombone
summary: Ory played up and down the road to Baton Rouge from age ten; his first horn cost $4 and had holes plastered with soap.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Now once you got your band organized with regular instruments, what happened next? What did you do?
Well, I played up and down the road from Laplace to Baton Rouge, all the sawmill towns, and for Kenner.
How old are you by this time?

Well, I was on the stand playing when I was 10 years old. I played my first job when I was 10 years old. Ten. Played for a big... Playing regular Val trombone. Val trombone. All the real instruments. Mm-hmm.
Was the good Val was a good instrument?
No. It wasn't real good. Had a few holes in it, and I plastered up with soap, you know.
The first one. Uh-huh. Only paid $4, so I... Uh-huh. But I mean, the real ones, I had a good one. Yeah. Had a yoke. Yeah. After I gave the picnic, you see. I see. And I bought real ones.
